library_preparation_preflight.summary: Meaningful coverage requires a Spring Boot Web MVC test context; the artifact does not transitively expose its upstream test infrastructure.

deterministic_setup.reason: Springdoc 3.0.3 is built against Spring Boot 4.0.5, and its upstream Web MVC UI tests use this starter for SpringBootTest, MockMvc, servlet, and embedded Web MVC support.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use a minimal nested Spring Boot application and controller with `@SpringBootTest` and `@AutoConfigureMockMvc`. Exercise `/v3/api-docs`, `/swagger-ui.html`, and a Swagger UI static resource or configuration endpoint. No external service or special environment property is required.
risks: A test limited to directly constructing UI helper classes may miss auto-configuration, controller discovery, resource transformation, and WebJar handling.
Keep the application context minimal because full Spring Boot startup can substantially increase Native Image build cost and test-only metadata.
